Name: More Geometric Rugs for AT
Author: 0Logophile0
Description:
[img]https://cdn.nest.rip/uploads/a7b74d72-698d-4825-b118-cec684e27bcd.png[/img]



[center][img]https://cdn.nest.rip/uploads/bfea5dbf-2fb4-4dbf-9977-31a06e1c3b5b.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]

[font=Tahoma][size=4]Welcome back to Logo's Rug Emporium, where you will find the latest in fashionable designs and palettes, all for the discerning decorator in mind.

Today's showcase features 8 new additional geometric rug designs, all available through Alternative Textures! By request we are now offering some designs in multiple sizes. Wahoo!
[/size][/font]


[center][img]https://cdn.nest.rip/uploads/e0da884a-7e45-4d22-b64e-2eed913ef76d.png[/img][/center]
[font=Tahoma][size=4]Download this mod and Alternative Textures. Plop into your /Mods folder.

Using these retextures is as easy as snapping your fingers:
1. For the large designs, get thyself a [b]MODERN RUG.[/b]
2. For the smaller designs, select from several base rug variations like the Cottage Rug and the Red Rug.
3. Equip your trusty paint bucket.
4. Swap textures!
[/size][/font]

[font=Tahoma][size=4]NEW! S﻿PECIAL REQUESTS:
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=4]See a rug design you love but would like in a different color? Drop a special order request in the comments section and we will consider it for the next version of this showcase! [/size][size=2](Fine Print: All requests will be contemplated and voted on by the Logo's Rug Emporium Leadership Team. In no way do we guarantee the fulfillment of any special request.)[/size][/font]

[center]
﻿[/center][center]﻿[/center][center][img]https://cdn.nest.rip/uploads/0c361ada-8b4e-4b91-8317-82def9746553.png[/img][/center][font=Tahoma][size=3]
These designs were inspired by IRL rugs, Moroccan tiles, and various geometric patterns.

And to the lovely people in the SDV Discord Modding community: Thanks for being you.
[/size][/font]
